notes: Six-face charge item encodes cleanly as activation family with a single charge_pool resource (cap=10, 1d6 dawn refill) and six grant_spell_access effects (charge_cast) in one direct phase. All spells share the same pool; per-face charge costs are expressed by charge_cast parameters. Fixed DC 17 carried on each grant via dcOverride. Follows the same pattern established by Staff of Fire (multi-spell charge item). No widening needed.
